name: Alice Lloyd College
tuition_note: From alc.edu/admissions/financial-aid/appalachian-leaders-college-scholarship (ALC's Tuition Guarantee page, dateModified 2026-02-25). Alice Lloyd is a work college that does not publish a dollar tuition sticker price; every qualified student from its 108-county Appalachian service area receives the Appalachian Leaders Scholarship covering the full cost of tuition, so the school's officially published out-of-pocket cost of tuition is $0. Housing = room only $2,398/semester x 2 = $4,796/year (food/board listed separately at $2,232/semester; matriculation fee $1,070/semester also separate). No explicit dollar tuition & fees rate is published on the official site.
